title: Scrub Brush With Adjustable Long Handle, Stiff Plastic Bristles
text:
Scrub Brush With Adjustable Long Handle, Stiff Plastic Bristles. This OXO GOOD GRIPS EXTENDABLE TILE & TUB BRUSH is basically just a scrub brush on a stick. The brush is high quality, but it only "pivots" up and down (instead of swiveling in all directions like a Swiffer mop). This limited pivot action makes the brush far less useful than I'd expected for scrubbing certain hard-to-reach tile areas alongside and behind the toilet in my condo's powder room. It takes some acrobatics to aim the rounded parts of the brush into the corners and oddly shaped areas.

Also, the brush has very stiff plastic (or maybe nylon) bristles that don't absorb water or floor-cleaning liquids at all. When I used my brush on the tile powder-room floor, it scrubbed the tile, but I still had to finish up with a mop and some extra hands-and-knees "detailing". At the end of the job, the brush needed cleaning, because it had picked up dirt bits.

The extendable handle adjusts to many different lengths. It took me a little while to figure out that you must twist the handle rods--not the colored plastic band that encircles one of the telescoping rods--in order to adjust the length.

Probably this brush works fairly well for tub and shower wall cleaning (using a powdered cleanser and rinsing with bath or shower water). However, it seems kind of expensive (about $15) for a nonabsorbent scrub brush with a handle. I rate it at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

description: The OXO Good Grips Extendable Tub and Tile Scrubber lets you clean the bathroom from top to bottom without climbing, crouching or kneeling. The Tub and Tile Scrubber extends from 26 inches to 42 inches with one quick twist, making it great for floors, tubs, glass shower doors, tile walls and more. The uniquely shaped Scrubber head pivots to clean at different angles and in tight corners. The lightweight steel pole is sturdy and features a soft, comfortable, non-slip grip, even when wet. Replacement Scrubber heads available separately.
